tasks.short: Prepare reports, invoices, letters and records with office software.

steps.what: Play the voice message and mark the figures and names.

loop.output: Names, dates and figures, each tied to a timestamp
loop.check: Secretary replays any figure the note will use
loop.stop: One pass; a mumbled figure is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Voice messages are not a form

steps.what: Choose the report, invoice or letter template.
Prepare invoices, letters and medical records from the notes.

loop.input: The marked notes and the chosen template
loop.output: A draft that uses only those notes
loop.check: Secretary checks every figure and every clinical term
loop.stop: One draft; a sentence with no note behind it is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The wording follows this message, not a single stored letter

steps.what: Check financial figures and clinical terms.
Send or file the checked letter, invoice or record.

tasks.design: A voice message is marked for names and figures, and a {DOCS} template starts the letter, invoice or record. The secretary checks every figure and clinical term, then sends or files that version. Native templates are tested before custom code. The draft is not pasted into a free chatbot.
tasks.previous_blocker: The secretary retyped the whole piece from a recording or a handwritten note, choosing the layout by eye.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and a marked recording remove the blank page. The check of figures and terms stays.
tasks.still_hard: Recordings that are hard to hear, and pieces that are a new kind of report with no template.
tasks.human_edge: The secretary hears when a figure in the recording cannot be the one the letter should carry.
tasks.altitude: Document time shrinks. The secretary can refuse to send a draft that contains a figure they did not hear.

reach.task: Prepare a standard letter from a case note
reach.learn: Which sentences they refuse to send without a source line

evidence.claim: In a civil-service trial, drafting time fell, scheduling took longer, and staff saw invented text. This is not a clinic result.
Pasting patients' medical data into a free chatbot was treated as a breach.

assumptions: Focal role is the medical secretary. Boundary: from a voice message or notes to an issued letter, invoice or record. The clinical content is the physician's.
Structured fields are addressee, document type, dates and amounts. The speaker produces the notes. Fallback: a figure that cannot be replayed is left blank.
Test native {DOCS} templates before custom code. A sentence with no note behind it is deleted. Works-council consent applies if recordings of staff are analysed, under the rule named in the digest.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers templates.
unknowns: Whether voice messages are already stored where the secretary works.
Which document types have a real template.
research_questions: What share of these documents is a repeat letter rather than a new report?

already_counted.description: Replay figures from the voice message
Edit the draft against the notes
Send or file the checked version

incremental.description: Revise letter, invoice and record templates

approvals.approved_version: document version whose figures the secretary checked

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the recording is unclear and there is no template, so the piece is still typed, and invented wording is the risk the civil-service trial already saw. High: a known template and a clear recording leave only the figure check. The check is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Post charges, send bills and keep the financial records.

steps.what: Post credits and charges in the financial records.
Prepare bills from the posted charges.
Review credits and collections before a bill goes out.
Send the bill or the collection note.
Record payments that match a bill.
Telephone a patient about an overdue balance.

tasks.design: Posted encounter charges prepare the bill in the {ERP}. The secretary reviews credits and collection cases, and only that accepted bill is sent. Matching payments post from the {BANK} line, with exceptions left for the secretary. A collection call stays a phone call. Native billing configuration is tested first.
tasks.previous_blocker: Charges were retyped onto a bill, and credits lived on a side list.
tasks.enabler_now: The encounter already holds the charge. A write-off and a collection call do not.
tasks.still_hard: Partial payments, disputed charges, and patients who should not be chased.
tasks.human_edge: The secretary knows which balance is a mistake and which one is owed.

ambition.what: The secretary decides, before a bill is sent, which credits and collection cases are ready and which must wait.

tasks.altitude: Credit decisions and collection calls stay on the week. The secretary can hold a bill.

reach.task: Post a payment against an account
reach.learn: How they leave a partial payment unmatched rather than force it

evidence.claim: A finance system can prepare a bill from posted charges and match a payment. Credits and collection calls stay with a person.
A bill that states a diagnosis is health data under GDPR article 9.

assumptions: Focal role is the medical secretary. Boundary: from encounter charges to a sent bill, a matched payment or a collection call. Setting fees is out of scope.

Structured fields are encounter identifier, amount, credit reason and payment reference. The encounter produces the charge. The bank produces the payment line. Fallback: an unmatched payment or a missing credit reason stays in a queue.
Test native {ERP} billing before custom code. A collection telephone call is not a template.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers fee codes and credit reasons.
unknowns: Whether encounter charges already post without retyping.
research_questions: What share of bills needs a credit or a collection call?

incremental.description: Update fee codes and credit reasons

approvals.approved_version: bill or collection note the secretary accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many bills need a credit or a dispute, so preparation stays manual and every collection is a call. High: standard charges bill themselves and only credits, exceptions and calls remain. The credit decision is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order supplies and keep the inventory at the par level.

steps.what: Count the inventory of supplies against the par level.
Raise a purchase request for items under par.
Approve the purchase request.
Place the approved order with the supplier.
Receive the delivery and update the inventory count.

tasks.design: The secretary still counts the storeroom. Items under par become a purchase request in {PROCUREMENT}. The practice manager approves it, and only that version is sent to the supplier. The secretary counts the delivery back in. Native purchasing configuration is tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The par level was a notebook, and orders were typed into mail.
tasks.enabler_now: A par level and a supplier catalogue can raise the request. The count and the receipt are still in the room.
tasks.still_hard: Substitutes, back orders, and items that look under par but are already on order.
tasks.human_edge: The secretary sees that a bin is empty because of a spill, not because of use.
tasks.altitude: Counts and deliveries stay on the week. The secretary can refuse to request an item the count does not support.

reach.role: Weighers, Measurers, Checkers, and Samplers, Recordkeeping
reach.task: Check a delivery against an order
reach.learn: How they record a short delivery without adjusting the par by hand

evidence.claim: A purchasing list can raise a request from a par level. Counting stock and checking a delivery stay in the room.

assumptions: Focal role is the medical secretary. Boundary: from a storeroom count to a received delivery. Choosing a new clinical product is out of scope.
Structured fields are item, par, on-hand count, supplier and quantity. The secretary produces the count. Fallback: a count that was not done does not raise a request.
Test native {PROCUREMENT} par levels before custom code. The order is not sent before approval.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers par levels and supplier codes.
unknowns: Whether a par level already exists for each clinical supply.
research_questions: How often is the storeroom counted today?

incremental.description: Update par levels and supplier codes

approvals.approved_version: purchase request the practice manager approved

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: counts are messy and many items have no par, so requests are still typed. High: pars are real and only the count, the approval and the receipt remain. The count is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Transcribe recorded diagnoses into the patient's medical record.

steps.what: Play the practitioner's recorded diagnosis.

loop.input: The recording of the diagnosis or recommendation
loop.output: A timed list of terms, blank where the audio is unclear
loop.check: Secretary replays every term that will be filed
loop.stop: One pass; unclear audio is marked, not guessed

steps.what: Transcribe diagnoses and recommendations into the medical record.

loop.input: The terms the secretary accepted from the recording
loop.output: A chart entry using only those terms
loop.check: Secretary edits the entry against the recording
loop.stop: One draft; a clinical line with no timestamp is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow this recording, and an edit cannot be skipped

steps.what: Confirm the diagnoses in the draft entry.
File the confirmed entry on the patient's record.
Correct lines the physician rejected.

tasks.design: A draft chart entry is prepared from the recording, and the secretary edits it against what was said. The physician confirms the diagnoses before that version is filed. Unclear audio is not guessed. The draft stays inside the record system. Native templates are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The secretary typed the whole note while replaying a recording, and errors were found later.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft from the recording can remove the blank page. Studies of edited drafts still leave a large edit, and quality can fall if the edit is skipped.
tasks.still_hard: Accents, two speakers, and a diagnosis the secretary must not invent.
tasks.human_edge: The secretary hears a word the draft got wrong and will not file it.
tasks.altitude: Transcription stays on the week as editing, not as retyping from silence. The secretary can send a line back to the physician.

reach.task: Type a record of what was said
reach.learn: How they mark a word they did not hear instead of filling it

evidence.claim: Autoscriber summarises a recorded consultation and the doctor pastes it into the record.
Juvoly turns speech into general-practice notes.
At Capio, self-estimated documentation time per note fell from 6.69 to 4.72 minutes. The study was commissioned by the vendor.
At LUMC, median documentation time fell from 202 seconds to 152 seconds after editing, and quality was lower. Vendor staff co-authored the study.
Health data is special-category data under GDPR article 9.
A filed summary is part of the medical file under the WGBO.
Transcription and usage dashboards need works-council consent.

assumptions: Focal role is the medical secretary who transcribes. Boundary: from a recording of a diagnosis or recommendation to a filed entry. The consultation itself is out of scope.

Structured fields are patient identifier, author and the sentences the secretary accepted. The practitioner produces the recording. Fallback: unclear audio is marked and typed by the secretary, or left out.

Test whether the record system already accepts a dictated template before custom code. The edit is not skipped. No recording is pasted into a free chatbot. Works-council consent is required before rollout.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers heading templates. The edit time is already in the remaining transcription step, not deducted again.
unknowns: Whether practitioners already record in a form the record system can store.
Whether the physician or the secretary is the person who may file.
research_questions: What share of recordings is clear enough that the edit is shorter than typing?

already_counted.description: Replay terms before they are used
Edit the draft against the recording

incremental.description: Maintain chart headings and the rule that an unsourced line is deleted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the recording is poor, so the edit takes as long as typing, which matches the quality drop when an edit is rushed. High: a clear recording shortens typing only. Capio's larger fall was self-estimated and vendor-commissioned, so the high case stays under it. Filing is never unattended.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still the phone, the front door and the desk. Standard bookings, bills and chart packs are ready to check. The secretary can refuse to file or send a record that failed the identity or recipient check.
reach: Eligibility interviewers: which intake questions must be asked aloud
Court clerks: which identity check they require before a copy leaves
Hotel desk clerks: how a busy desk looks up a name without losing the queue
skills_to_grow: Reading a clinical term before it is filed
Maintaining a booking rule and a prep line
Spotting a result that must be phoned, not routed
role.ambitious_version: Every result has an owner, every disclosure names the recipient, and no chart line is filed before a person has read it.
